         return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, { dateStyle: date.format, timeStyle: date.format }).format(date.date);

     var fillPost = function (element, post) {

         return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, { dateStyle: date.format, timeStyle: date.format }).format(date.date);

       if(name)    name.innerText = post.blogAuthor.fullName;

         return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, { dateStyle: date.format, timeStyle: date.format }).format(date.date);

     var fillPost = function (element, post) {

         return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, { dateStyle: date.format, timeStyle: date.format }).format(date.date);

       if(name)    name.innerText = post.blogAuthor.fullName;

         return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locales, { dateStyle: date.format, timeStyle: date.format }).format(date.date);

     var fillPost = function (element, post) {
